title: The Beginning is Melting
description: A surreal psychedelic landscape features a glowing green skeletal dragon standing in a swirling green vortex, a hooded grim reaper-like figure emitting pink and blue liquid light from its hands, and a medieval castle on a hill surrounded by glowing spiral portals. A winding blue river flows through the scene past a wooden sign reading 'THE BEGINNING IS MELTING' while smiley faces drip from the sky, mountains, and cliffs under a crescent moon.
